sources.observation: Refraction has independent Death-only bonus/defense pools. Flat attack damage is determined at attack beginning; a newly gained pool can be consumed by an older in-flight hit without increasing its damage. Damage below5after reductions is ignored. False Promise outranks defense but still consumes a qualifying charge, while Aphotic Shield is lower.
